questions.question: Which conditions must an economic activity meet to count as environmentally sustainable under the EU Taxonomy?
questions.answer: Four: it contributes substantially to one or more environmental objectives, does no significant harm to any of them, complies with the minimum safeguards, and meets the technical screening criteria.
evidence: an economic activity shall qualify as environmentally sustainable where that economic activity

questions.question: When can an activity with no low-carbon alternative still count as contributing substantially to climate change mitigation?
questions.answer: When it supports the transition to a climate-neutral economy consistent with a pathway to limit warming to 1.5 degrees C above pre-industrial levels (a transitional activity), under further conditions in the same paragraph.
evidence: an economic activity for which there is no technologically and economically feasible low-carbon alternative shall qualify as contributing substantially to climate change mitigation where it supports the transition to a climate-neutral economy

questions.question: Which expert body does the Commission set up under the Taxonomy Regulation?
evidence: The Commission shall establish a Platform on Sustainable Finance

questions.where: Directive (EU) 2022/2464, Article 1(4), new Article 19a(7) of Directive 2013/34/EU
questions.question: Until when may listed small and medium-sized companies decide not to include sustainability reporting in their management report?
questions.answer: For financial years starting before 1 January 2028.
evidence: For financial years starting before 1 January 2028, by way of derogation from paragraph 1 of this Article, small and medium-sized undertakings which are public-interest entities

questions.where: Directive (EU) 2022/2464, Article 1(4), new Article 19a(3) of Directive 2013/34/EU
questions.question: For how long may a company that cannot get all the value chain information explain its efforts instead?
questions.answer: For the first three years of application of the measures Member States adopt under the CSRD.
evidence: first three years of the application of the measures to be adopted by the Member States in accordance with Article 5(2) of Directive (EU) 2022/2464

questions.where: Delegated Regulation (EU) 2023/2772, Annex I, ESRS 1, paragraph 77(a)
questions.question: What period is the short-term time horizon in the ESRS?
questions.answer: The period the company adopts as the reporting period in its financial statements.
evidence: for the short-term time horizon: the period adopted by the undertaking as the reporting period in its financial statements

questions.where: Delegated Regulation (EU) 2023/2772, Annex I, ESRS 1, paragraph 45
questions.question: What decides whether an actual or a potential negative impact is material under the ESRS?
questions.answer: Severity for an actual negative impact; severity and likelihood for a potential negative impact.
evidence: For actual negative impacts, materiality is based on the severity of the impact, while for potential negative impacts it is based on the severity and likelihood of the impact

questions.where: Delegated Regulation (EU) 2023/2772, Annex I, ESRS 1, Appendix C, row ESRS E1 E1-6
questions.question: Which companies may leave out Scope 3 emissions in the first year of their sustainability statement?
questions.answer: Undertakings or groups with on average no more than 750 employees during the financial year.
evidence: not exceeding on their balance sheet dates the average number of 750 employees during the financial year (on a consolidated basis where applicable) may omit the datapoints on scope 3 emissions

questions.where: Delegated Regulation (EU) 2023/2772, Annex I, ESRS E1, Disclosure Requirement E1-7
questions.question: Which ESRS E1 disclosure requirement covers GHG removals and carbon credits?
questions.answer: Disclosure Requirement E1-7, GHG removals and GHG mitigation projects financed through carbon credits.
evidence: Disclosure Requirement E1-7 - GHG removals and GHG mitigation projects financed through carbon credits

questions.question: What internal carbon price per tonne of CO2 does ESRS E1 require companies to apply?
questions.why: Disclosure Requirement E1-8 asks whether the company uses internal carbon pricing and which prices it applies, with their source; it sets no price level.
